summary: Full E2E test of KUN Workspace Admin Dashboard (CMS + Booking + Auth). 28/28 backend pytest tests passed. All 8 admin pages render, login/logout flow works, public site loads dynamic data from DB. One minor schema-quality issue found (non-blocking).

minor.issue: ContentBlockIn pydantic schema requires 'key' in request body even though the key comes from the URL path. Request without 'key' in body returns 422. Frontend Content.jsx happens to send it, so UI works, but the schema should drop 'key' (or make it optional) to avoid surprises. Fix: remove 'key' from ContentBlockIn or make Optional.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove 'key' field from ContentBlockIn pydantic model (backend/models/schemas.py) since it's provided via URL path in PUT /api/admin/content/{key}. Not blocking — frontend already sends key in body.
OPTIONAL: The 401 errors logged in browser console on public pages come from AuthContext calling /auth/me on mount. Consider silencing the 401 log (try/catch) or only probing on admin routes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS middleware is added AFTER routers. Works because FastAPI applies middleware globally, but convention is to add CORS BEFORE include_router for clarity.
ContentBlockIn schema requires 'key' in body — duplicates path param on PUT /api/admin/content/{key}. Minor DRY issue.
AuthContext probes /auth/me on every page load including public pages, producing 401 console errors on non-admin pages. Harmless but noisy.
Admin.py StaffCreate does not validate email format (uses str, not EmailStr) while auth.LoginRequest does — inconsistent validation.
verify_password catches bare Exception — OK but hides real bcrypt errors during debugging.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@kun.com / Kun@9632147 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — verified working, bcrypt hash $2b$ format)
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed. Tests create and cleanup TEST_-prefixed records (offices, rooms, content blocks, bookings, messages, staff users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs (auth + public + admin CRUD + roles) validated. Cookie-based JWT auth works (SameSite=None, Secure=True). Meeting-room duplicate slot correctly 409. Staff role correctly blocked from admin-only mutations (403). Own-account delete correctly blocked (400). Full admin dashboard UI renders in Arabic RTL, all 8 sections navigable, logout works, and public / /spaces /contact pages load dynamic data from DB. No blocker for shipping.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Only minor schema DRY violation: PUT /api/admin/content/{key} requires 'key' in body. Reproduce: `curl -X PUT .../api/admin/content/foo -d '{"ar":{},"en":{}}'` → 422. Mitigation: make key Optional or drop from ContentBlockIn.
